transcript: Education is a basic right of every person The United Nations has declared the right to education As one of the universal human rights In reality, however, the opportunity for education differs greatly depending on the country where one is born and one's family income. There are still tens of millions of children worldwide who cannot attend school. Even among developed countries, there are large gaps in access to and the quality of education. The economic condition of a family greatly shapes a child's future career. Education is not only the passing on of knowledge. It is a process by which an individual forms their identity and grows into a responsible member of society Many countries, through scholarships and reduced tuition are trying to open the opportunity for higher education to more young people The reform proceeds slowly but it does proceed to create a truly equal society Every child must be given the same opportunity for education Only when education is equal Does the gap in society begin to close
